findings.location: prepare.py binary attestation and campaign.py prepared build admission
findings.observed: prepare.py copies current source and records its hashes, but can include an existing target/debug binary after --test only; campaign.py accepts any successful command containing build OR test.
findings.impact: A reused work directory could pair a stale binary with newly copied client source hashes. This is a reachable runner path, not an observed failure of the present binary.
findings.minimal_repair: Require the exact successful cargo build --locked --bin bass-s9-vigilode with bound source/binary receipt, or an explicit verified reusable build attestation. Test-only preparation must not claim to build the existing binary.

findings.location: campaign.py raw JSON load/assess before PROCESS.json
findings.observed: RAW exists -> json.loads -> assess execute before saving PROCESS, without a readback/observer exception handler.
findings.impact: A truncated existing RAW or observer exception can terminate the matrix before recording the process outcome and classified failure for that case. Original raw/log bytes remain but the promised receipt/checkpoint is missing.
findings.minimal_repair: Write PROCESS immediately after process termination, preserve RAW/log, catch and classify readback/observer exceptions, write ASSESSMENT and checkpoint before continuing. Keep timeout exit124 independently visible.
